_doc: GIA CHOT TAM (pinned) - CHI dung khi cao that su KHONG ra duoc gia.
Day KHONG phai cho de ep gia. Quy tac:
- Chi ap dung khi scan_one tra ve status != active hoac khong co rrp.
- Neu dot quet cao duoc gia that, muc nay bi BO QUA va scraper in canh bao
de nhac go muc di. Gia that LUON thang gia chot tam.
- Dong duoc ap gia chot tam mang kind = "pin" de nhin la biet ngay.
LY DO TON TAI: mot so PDP cua TGDD la Marketing Landing Page, khong render khoi gia
tinh nao (khong co box-price, khong data-priceorg, khong ca the <main>). Card danh muc
brand hub chi mang gia cua DUNG MOT bien the (bien the chinh cua card), cac nut pill SKU
con lai khong kem gia. Tab #o=3 khong liet ke dong nay. Tuc la khong co nguon song nao.
Truoc day cac con so nay nam THANG trong scan_tgdd.py duoi dang `result.update({...})`
GHI DE len ket qua cao - ghi de VO DIEU KIEN, ke ca khi cao duoc gia that. Do la dung
lop loi da ghim iPhone 18 Pro vao "chua mo ban" suot 24 dot (CONSTRAINTS 2.9).
maxAgeDays: qua so ngay nay ma muc chua duoc doi soat lai thi CONG CHAN. Doi soat lai
= mo PDP hoac card brand hub, xac nhan so lieu, roi cap nhat `since`. Day la co y:
mot hang so khong ai nhin lai thi khong duoc phep di qua lang le.
